[EN] Dougal has a special training mission for the Idoneal Force.

Prove your power by defeating 10 Brutal Basilisks on the Island of Dawn and completing a Guardian Legion mission.

- Use the Vanguard Requests window to teleport to the Island of Dawn.
- Warriors, lancers, berserkers, slayers, priests, mystics, and brawlers can receive Apex quests upon reaching item level 439.
- Enchanting weapons can greatly increase your item level.
- The document "Apex Mission 428" vanishes when you accept this quest.
[ES] Dougal tiene una misión de entrenamiento especial para la Idoneal Force.

Demuestra tu poder derrotando a 10 Brutal Basilisks en Island of Dawn y completando una misión de Guardian Legion.

- Usa la ventana de Vanguard Requests para teletransportarte a Island of Dawn.
- Warriors, lancers, berserkers, slayers, priests, mystics y brawlers pueden recibir misiones de Apex al alcanzar el nivel de objeto 439.
- Encantar armas puede aumentar enormemente tu nivel de objeto.
- El documento "Apex Mission 428" desaparece cuando aceptas esta misión.

[EN] Thank you, . It's always a joy to watch you work.

Don't forget to claim your reward.

Keep up the good work.
[ES] Gracias, . Siempre es un placer verte trabajar.

No olvides reclamar tu recompensa.

Sigue con el buen trabajo.
